ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_MIRROR_IMAGE.title: Mirror Image
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_MIRROR_IMAGE.descrip: Your phantom doubles (max 8). Cards you Exhaust are stored into free mirrors; the first card you play yourself each turn, if it wasn't exhausted, also imprints an [gold]Exhaust[/gold] copy into a mirror. At the start of your turn, each loaded mirror plays its stored card at a random enemy — cards with [gold]Exhaust[/gold] then go to the exhaust pile, others stay in the mirror and fire again. Each instance of unblocked damage you take kills one mirror (empty ones first, then newest-loaded; its card falls back to the exhaust pile). When a card actively destroys a mirror, the stored card is played first.
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_FIRST_MOVE.title: First Move
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_FIRST_MOVE.descripti: Triggers only if this is the first card you play this turn.
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_TRANSMUTE.title: Transmute
ILLUSIONIST_KEYWORD_TRANSMUTE.descriptio: [gold]Transform[/gold] a card. At the start of your next turn, [gold]transform[/gold] it into what it was before that [gold]transform[/gold].
